game: IND @ MIN, Week 7 2026 / kickoff not in pack / MIN -7 / total 41.5 / weather not saved; dome vs outdoor not in pack

script.base: Books have a controlled MIN win, not a shootout: MIN -7, total 41.5, implied MIN 24.2 / IND 17.2. MIN leads by about a score after halftime and runs the clock with Aaron Jones (62 carries, 265 rush yards in weeks 3-5) into an IND run defense allowing 5.01 YPC and 15 runs of 10+. IND, trailing as a 7-point dog, throws more, but MIN blitzes 70% and Tyler Warren (14 targets, 124 yards, 107 air yards in weeks 4-6) is out, so the extra throws are short — Keenan Allen (20 targets), Laquon Treadwell (19), Josh Downs (18) and RB checkdowns — not a track meet.
script.flip1: IND hangs within a score into the fourth. Jonathan Taylor keeps the 18-carry role (56 carries, 234 yards in three games) and can still post the 95 and 94 rush games from his last four. MIN cannot only salt it with Jones, so Kyler Murray throws and Hockenson (18 targets) plus Addison (15 targets, 202 air yards) stay live against a Gardner-less secondary. Jones's 39.5 rush number still holds on a lead-back share.
script.flip2: MIN jumps out and leads by 14+ (the 38-21 template). Jones's carries come early and he is a rest risk late, but 12 first-half carries at IND's 5.01 YPC still clear 39.5. Taylor's rush line dies (his 45-yard game is the template) as IND abandons the run. Allen (63/45/82 in three of the last four) and Treadwell (42/34) become the live overs; Murray does not need designed runs.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game report only; inactives (~90 minutes out) are not in the pack. IND TE Tyler Warren Out (groin) vacates 14 targets / 124 yards / 107 air yards from weeks 4-6. Next TE Will Mallory has one listed game at 20 rec yards and no two-sided price, so do not assign him the role. Targets already on the sheet should absorb it: Allen 20, Treadwell 19, Downs 18, Taylor 12, plus Taylor checkdowns if the 70% MIN blitz gets home. IND WR Anthony Gould Out (concussion) is depth only. IND CB Sauce Gardner Out (calf) and CB Justin Walley Questionable (knee) put MIN WRs, especially Addison, on backups; IND already allows 7.16-8.72 YPA by side and 16 passes of 20+ (198 yards). IND LB CJ Allen Out (ankle) and LB Bryce Boettcher Questionable (groin) thin the run fit and the TE/RB coverage, which helps Jones and Hockenson. MIN RB Jordan Mason is Questionable (thumb), not out, and is absent from the weeks 3-5 rush tree (Jones 62, Murray 12, Claiborne 6, Dallas 1); if he sits or is limited, Jones stays the bellcow, and if he splits, Jones's carry ceiling drops. Sources: pack injury report and the week-window rush/target lines.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone chart in the pack. Location splits only. MIN (5 games): left 6.22 YPA on 55 throws, middle 9.21 on 34, right 4.88 on 66 — middle is open, right is the strength. IND (6 games): left 7.78 on 64, middle 8.72 on 36, right 7.16 on 88 — soft on every side, middle worst.
matchup.pressure: MIN blitz rate 70%. IND EPA/dropback is -0.07 vs the blitz and -0.18 with no blitz, so the blitz does not uniquely wreck IND, but by role it still favors quick throws over Treadwell's 12.7 aDOT (241 air yards on 19 targets). IND blitzes only 21%. MIN EPA/dropback is -0.23 when blitzed and +0.08 when not, so MIN gets the efficient version of its offense in this game.
matchup.bleeds: MIN bleeds the middle (9.21 YPA) and has allowed 12 passes of 20+ (172 yards); its run defense is fine at 4.01 YPC with 11 runs of 10+. IND bleeds the run (5.01 YPC, 15 runs of 10+) and the pass everywhere (16 passes of 20+ for 198 yards).
matchup.overlap: The core overlap is Jones's carry share (62 of the listed MIN rushes in three games) into IND's 5.01 YPC run defense with CJ Allen out and Boettcher questionable. Hockenson (team-high 18 targets, 137 yards) into IND's middle 8.72 and those same LBs is the pass overlap, but last four 29/11/119/7 puts the non-spike baseline under 36.5, so it is not a leg. Addison into Gardner's absence is real, but weeks 3-5 receiving yards reconcile to 0+90+52 and a run-lean script can stall him. Allen is IND's top target (20/127) but 41.5 already matches his 42.3 L3 average, and there is no chart putting him in MIN's middle bleed.

pro_edge.implied_totals: MIN 24.2, IND 17.2. Check: (41.5+7)/2 = 24.25 and (41.5-7)/2 = 17.25, matching the saved scan.
pro_edge.script_read: A 24.2/17.2 split on a 41.5 total is run-leaning, not a volume shootout. At -7 the dog throws more and the leader runs late, so Jones's carries go up and Taylor's rush is at risk if IND trails. -7 is not a blowout flag, so starter snaps should last; a true blowout is the second flip, not the base. Size Jones from carry share applied to that team volume, not from the raw 88-yard average alone.
pro_edge.best_price: No Pinnacle in the pack; anchor is consensus no-vig. Jones rushyds 39.5: no-vig over 0.502 / under 0.498, best over -115, best under -113, and the saved main over is -115. Fair on the over is about even money, so -115 is juice, not a soft book. The edge is the 39.5 rung. Jones rushrec 57.5 no-vig over 0.497, best over -114. Treadwell 19.5 is -115/-115, no-vig 0.500. Addison 38.5 is -113/-113, no-vig 0.500. Hockenson's best over -112 (no-vig over 0.497) is the least-juiced real over and still not a book discrepancy. No two-sided price on Mallory 20, McGowan 14, Downs 50, Jefferson 74, Mason 48, or Jones rec 15.
pro_edge.lagging: No cross-book outlier is saved; prices sit on consensus. The lag is the rung versus the role: Jones rush 39.5 and rush+rec 57.5 are coin-flip priced against a 58 rush floor and a 92 rush+rec floor in the last four, and against 62 carries in three games. Treadwell 19.5 is coin-flip priced against 20/42/34/21. Addison and Hockenson are still 0.500 after Gardner and Warren were ruled out. Cannot prove a stale book without a reprice diff.
pro_edge.sleepers: OUT for the sleeper check: Warren (TE), Gould (WR), Gardner (CB), CJ Allen (LB). Same-position Mallory recyds 20 has no two-sided price and one game at 20 yards — low confidence, not a leg. Gardner out should help MIN outside WRs, but Addison 38.5 has not been shaved and Jefferson 74 has no price plus a prop log of no prior games against a team line of 9/111/92, so he is unusable. Mason is Questionable, not Out or Doubtful, so he is not a sleeper trigger; if he is later ruled out, Jones's number is already the beneficiary and Mason 48 (no price, one game of 59) stays off the card. Walley and Boettcher are still Questionable.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Aaron Jones is the MIN bellcow (62 carries and 265 rush yards, plus 17 targets, in three games) in a MIN -7 clock-control script against an IND run defense allowing 5.01 YPC with LB CJ Allen out, and the rush line is 39.5, 18 yards under his worst game of the last four (58, 94, 105, 113).
edge_players.must_be_true: Jones plays a full lead-back share, Mason either sits or stays a complement rather than a 50/50 split, and MIN is not trailing late so the run script stays on. Mason is only questionable; inactives are not locked.
edge_players.kills_it: Mason is active and takes the majority of the carries, or MIN falls behind early and Murray throws Jones off the field before 10 carries. A 10-carry day under 4.0 YPC also misses 39.5. No final inactive list is in the pack.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Jones under 39.5 cashed. Mason played through the thumb and split the backfield, Jones had 9 carries for 31 yards before MIN went pass-heavy to answer an IND lead, and the 105/94/113 games were Mason-out volume that the 39.5 line was already fading. The coin-flip price was the market knowing the role, not a stale number, and there was no inactive list yet to confirm Mason was out. That counter is real but weaker than the read: Mason is only questionable, he is not in the three-game carry tree, IND allows 5.01 YPC, and even a 12-carry complement day at that efficiency clears 39.5.
slip_story: MIN-controls-the-clock stack: favorite runs late, low-moderate total, Jones rush over is the anchor. It belongs with a game or MIN team-total under, not with IND WR overs or a total over that need a shootout. No TD legs. One prop from this game; morning read only, because Mason, Walley, and Boettcher are still questionable and inactives are not in the pack.
